news.title: Stocks gain for a second day on hope Iran ceasefire can be sustained: Live updates
news.description: The S&P 500 moved into positive territory on Thursday, even as the price of U.S. oil touched $100 per barrel.

news.title: The Strait of Hormuz is not open as Iran controls access after ceasefire, UAE oil CEO says
news.description: Sultan Ahmed Al Jaber demanded a full reopening of the strait, warning that the oil supply disruption will increase if Iran maintains control of the passage.
